# harebear-ui

> Opinionated, pre-themed React component library: shadcn/ui primitives restyled to one design system, plus admin, data, and AI chat components. React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix, TypeScript. Ships its Tailwind theme.

## Setup in an app

1. `npm i harebear-ui` (peers: react, react-dom 19; tailwindcss 4).
2. `npx harebear-ui init` wires the CSS import and agent docs, or do it by hand: in the main CSS file, `@import "tailwindcss";` then `@import "harebear-ui/styles.css";`.
3. Wrap the app: `<ThemeProvider><TooltipProvider>{app}<Toaster /></TooltipProvider></ThemeProvider>`.
4. Import everything from the root: `import { Button, Card, DataTable } from "harebear-ui"`.

## Rules

- Use harebear-ui components before writing new UI. Primitives keep shadcn/ui names and props.
- Style with theme tokens only: bg-background, bg-card, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, bg-primary, bg-primary-soft, text-success, text-warning, text-destructive, border-border, shadow-card, rounded-md/lg/xl. No hex colors or Tailwind palette colors.
- Status is a tone: success | warning | danger | info | neutral.
- Icons: lucide-react elements, e.g. `<SearchIcon />`. Icon-only buttons need aria-label.
- Change the brand with `<ThemeProvider accent="#hex" radius={14}>` or `--brand` / `--radius` in CSS.

## Docs

- [Component catalog](docs/COMPONENTS.md): every export with props and examples. In an installed app: node_modules/harebear-ui/docs/COMPONENTS.md
- Look up single entries instead of reading it all: `npx harebear-ui docs DataTable StatCard` (export names, a prefix like `Prompt`, or a section like `Tokens`). Exits 1 when nothing matches.
- [Getting started](docs/guides/getting-started.md): setup for Vite, Next.js App Router and React Router v7, plus troubleshooting.
- [Theming](docs/guides/theming.md): ThemeProvider props, CSS token overrides, fonts, SSR.
- [Working with AI agents](docs/guides/agents.md): what init installs, per-tool setup, prompts, review checklist.
- [Agent skill](skills/harebear-ui/SKILL.md): Claude Code skill, installed by `npx harebear-ui init`.
- [Example screens](https://github.com/hmilbradt/harebear-ui/tree/main/playground/screens): admin dashboard, AI chat, data table + detail panel, status home page, auth pages, component catalog.
- [Source](https://github.com/hmilbradt/harebear-ui)

## Component index

Theme: ThemeProvider, useTheme, ThemeToggle, ThemeScript
Layout/admin: SidebarLayout, SidebarCollapseButton, AppShell, AppBrand, PageHeader, StatCard, SearchInput, StatusDot, StatusBadge, UsageMeter, ActivityFeed, Timeline, KeyValueGrid, UserChip, UserMenu, Callout, LinkTile, ConfirmDialog, CopyField
Data: DataTable, createDataTableColumnHelper, TrendChart, TrendLegend, BarList, Sparkline, StatusBars
AI/chat composites: ChatShell, ChatPanel, ChatThread, ChatMessage, AssistantAvatar, MessageActions, PromptInput, PromptInputChip, PromptInputSelect, ModelPicker, ConversationList, NewConversationButton, groupByDate, formatWhen, ToolCall, ToolGroup, ToolStep, ToolStatusIcon, ApprovalCard, ApprovalResult, TypingIndicator, CodeSnippet, InlineCode, Prose
AI/chat primitives (shadcn): Message, Bubble, MessageScroller, Attachment, Trace, Marker, Questionnaire, CodeBlock
Auth: AuthLayout, LoginForm, SignupForm, GitHubIcon, GoogleIcon, AppleIcon
Primitives (the full shadcn/ui registry): Accordion, Alert, AlertDialog, AspectRatio, Attachment, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Bubble, Button, ButtonGroup, Calendar, Card, Carousel, Chart, Checkbox, CodeBlock, Collapsible, Combobox, Command, ContextMenu, Dialog, DirectionProvider, Drawer, DropdownMenu, Empty, Field, HoverCard, Input, InputGroup, InputOTP, Item, Kbd, Label, Marker, Menubar, Message, MessageScroller, NativeSelect, NavigationMenu, Pagination, Popover, Progress, Questionnaire, RadioGroup, Resizable, ScrollArea, Select, Separator, Sheet, Sidebar, Skeleton, Slider, Spinner, Switch, Table, Tabs, Textarea, Toaster, Toggle, ToggleGroup, Tooltip, Trace
Hooks/utils: useCopyToClipboard, useHighlightedCode, useIsMobile, useMediaQuery, useSidebarOptional, cn
